content: AutoJudge is characterized by the incorporation of pair-wise attentive reader, law articles, and a CNN output layer, as well as some pre-processing with legal prior. We design ablation tests respectively to evaluate the effectiveness of these modules. When taken off the attention mechanism, AutoJudge degrades into a GRU on which a CNN is stacked. When taken off law articles, the CNN output layer only takes INLINEFORM0 as input. Besides, our model is tested respectively without name-replacement or unsupervised selection of law articles (i.e. passing the whole law text). As mentioned above, we system use law articles extracted with unsupervised method, so we also experiment with ground-truth law articles.
